name: TaskMaster
description: description: > Runs Jellyfin scheduled tasks sequentially inside a configurable time window, ordered by fastest or slowest completion time. Includes backup and restore of native triggers, a take-over/release workflow, and detection of newly added tasks.

versions.changelog:
changelog: > changelog: > 1.0.0.2 - Sync the Scheduled Tasks trigger with the configured StartTime on save. 1.0.0.1 - Detect and import new tasks. 1.0.0.0 - Initial release.
  - Sequential task execution with fastest-first or slowest-first ordering
- Configurable time window with overnight support - Per-task day-of-week exclusions - Backup, restore, and download of native task triggers - Take over / Release workflow that preserves startup triggers - Detection of newly added and orphaned tasks - Drag-and-drop task reordering
